arguments.message: Hi! When a record is newly created, the search index is updated shortly after the record is added. Browsing shows it immediately, but search may lag by a few minutes. Usually the record will appear in search within a couple of minutes without any action needed. If it still doesn’t show up after several minutes, that’s beyond normal indexing lag and you should report it so we can investigate further. Let me know if you need help filing a report!
